note: B reads the axial-stiffness curve correctly at several span stations (≈4.5e10 N at r/R=0, 2.1e10 at 0.2, 2.2e10 at 0.4, 1.8e10 at 0.6) and gives root stiffness values without the contradictory duplicates that plague A (mass density 3100 vs 3000 kg/m, torsional 0.8/0.9/1.0e11, edge 1.4/1.5e11, axial 4.5/4.7e10 all at r/R=0, plus flap 1.2e11 where the Flap curve starts near 1.5e11). A also misbinds planform geometry, calling the geometric center 2 m at the root and the shear center −4 m at r/R=0.2, which are the planform edge and the axis extreme, not the center curves. B is not clean either: it omits the mass-density root value, repeats the same shear-center −4 m error plus a −3 m root reading taken from the lower planform edge, and carries two valueless 'position along span' claims.
